coverage: extension-check scans button, input, select and textarea openings in extensions/popup.html.
Each interactive control must expose a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby; failures report the control type, source and line.
Offline self-tests cover valid multi-control markup plus missing-name and empty-name rejection; the real popup passes at two named controls.

limitations: The gate is a source-level accessibility regression check, not a browser UI Automation runtime audit.
No physical-audio, driver install/load, HLK, Microsoft signing or vendor ASIO control is claimed.
